rules.when: Mobile or web UI implementation, visual design judgment, accessibility, animation, layout, visual verification, unusually ambiguous debugging, or a risky implementation.
rules.why: Opus 5 is strongest on difficult multi-file work and finishes tasks rather than leaving stubs.

rules.when: A narrow mechanical change: formatting, renaming, dependency metadata, straightforward docs, routine test maintenance.
rules.why: Bounded, predictable work does not need a frontier model at high effort.

_notes.bosun: Not listed under roles: the bosun is the session you are already in, and a skill cannot change its own model. Set it at launch instead, e.g. `claudel --model sonnet --effort medium`, Conductor's per-workspace model setting, or the `model` key in your config directory's settings.json. Sonnet 5 at medium effort is the recommended shape.
_notes.effort: low | medium | high | xhigh | max. xhigh is the documented sweet spot for coding and agentic work; low is right for scouting and simple tasks. Effort defaults carried over from an older model are usually wrong.
_notes.models: claude side accepts an alias (fable, opus, sonnet, haiku) or a full id (claude-opus-5). codex side takes a slug: gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna.
_notes.dispatch: Rules are read top to bottom by the bosun when it picks a model for a hand; the first match wins, otherwise default. They are prose on purpose, so the bosun judges the fit.
